name: railway-mcp
description: Railway deployment, log access, and environment variable management. Use for deploying the Fastify API and BullMQ worker services.
rules: Never set secrets directly — use Railway's secret store
Always check deployment status after deploying
Tail logs for at least 30 seconds after a new deployment to catch startup errors
The API service and BullMQ worker are two separate Railway services
Never delete a service without explicit instruction
